source_deployment.title: 京观 · 北京城市三维漫游

summary: 京观 · 北京城市三维漫游升级至 v2，沿用 m154，统一目录仍为 154 项。
新增古建近观、七个观察视角、十个实景对照影像、360° 球形全景和沉浸模式；保留原始源码、公开地理数据与摄影许可。
真实 HTTPS 入口、资源字节、地图数据下载和浏览器操作通过，未使用本地资源替代线上文件。

changes: Preserve v1 dynamic photo URL mapping and CPU imagery URL/CORS adaptations.
Enable anonymous cross-origin image loading for spherical panorama pixel readback.

assessment.reason: All nine functional groups passed. The aggregate assertion included an optional weather-service CORS console error; the UI fallback worked. The console event is now classified separately, and a real browser retry returned HTTP 200 with live weather.

limitations: Building dimensions and details partly use estimates; imagery and terrain have differing epochs, and this is not a survey model or real-world navigation.
Sky photographs simulate weather and do not claim to depict Beijing or historical weather. Actual Open-Meteo responses are recorded separately.
No exhaustive collision, long-duration tour, all-device or frame-rate benchmark.
Existing 19 missing-source catalogue deliveries remain unchanged; no inaccessible chats or attachments were claimed to be read.
